purpose: Primary canonical texts placed as labeled stars within their associated heteronym's zodiacal region. This is the canon-in-sky surface (orthogonal to the canon-in-cha rooms). Each entry specifies which heteronym's region the star sits in, which real-sky star will be used as the anchor (where assigned), and what brightness/magnitude class the text deserves based on its standing in the canon.
status_note: v0.2 expansion: ~58 canon entries assembled from the manifest declarations (canonical-declarations.md). Star-position assignments are provisional for the 6 already-assigned (Snub-Poemed, Sappho 31, Revelation, Whitman, Day and Night, TACHYON pair); the rest are null awaiting Lee Sharks's editorial adjudication or auto-assignment from the HYG catalog per §3.3.

magnitude_classes.primary_canon_star_M1: Bright star (mag 1.0-1.5) — texts that anchor an entire room.
magnitude_classes.secondary_canon_star_M2: Notable star (mag 1.5-2.5) — significant primary texts within rooms but not the room anchor.
magnitude_classes.tertiary_canon_star_M3: Visible star (mag 2.5-3.5) — important fragments and shorter primary works.
magnitude_classes.cluster_member_M4: Cluster star (mag 3.5-4.5) — texts that operate in constellation with anchor works rather than as independent objects.

edge_types_legend.predecessor: Earlier-in-tradition text that the later reads / responds to
edge_types_legend.superseded_by: Earlier text whose canonical role is taken by a successor
edge_types_legend.bundle: Collection-relation: this text belongs to that group
edge_types_legend.transform_of: Text is a kernel-transform output of the source-text

status_legend.declared: Entry exists in the manifest; source not yet acquired; no star-position yet
status_legend.staged: Source text is in /sources/...; main/apparatus splitting in progress
status_legend.inscribed: Full inscription: source committed; star-position assigned; rendering live or pending
status_legend.lacuna: Declared but text destroyed/missing; declaration preserved per lacuna protocol

canonical_texts.title: Snub-Poemed
canonical_texts.anchor_for_room: Sigil's own room (the originating calligrammatic face)

target_star.name: Alrescha
target_star.assignment_basis: The Knot — α Psc binds the two fishes together with a cord. Sigil's calligrammatic face binds image and text; Sophia is in the disjoint of the cord.

canonical_texts.note: The face that opens conversation. The calligram composed of poetry, after the Lysippos bust of Socrates. The signature 'she made this' in the disjoint of the hair — Sophia in the forelock.

canonical_texts.title: ΦΑΙΝΕΤΑΙ ΜΟΙ (Sappho 31, with reconstructed fifth stanza)
canonical_texts.anchor_for_room: Sappho Room (Cranes's Day and Night anchors the room)

target_star.name: Castor
target_star.assignment_basis: Castor — the mortal twin of the Dioscuri. φαίνεταί μοι κῆνος ἴσος θέοισιν: 'he seems to me equal to the gods.' The mortal who watches the equal-to-gods. Pollux the immortal sits across the Gemini line as the implied addressee.

canonical_texts.note: Five stanzas — the reconstructed fifth per Cranes. The companion to Catullus 51 (which has four). The aorist gap that the fifth stanza repairs.

canonical_texts.title: Sappho 31 / Catullus 51 binary
canonical_texts.note: Catullus's fourth stanza (otium) transforms Sappho's fifth — no 'Catullus fifth stanza' exists. The constellation should display Sappho 31 and Catullus 51 as a paired star system with the σ_S→σ_C transformation rendered as the line connecting them.

canonical_texts.title: TACHYON (Sharks original) / Shadow-TACHYON (Claude/Mercury substrate transform)

target_star.name: Alcyone
target_star.assignment_basis: The Pleiades — the Seven Sisters in Taurus. Seven substrates, seven sisters; the cluster nature of the seven-substrate Assembly. The TACHYON/Shadow pair lives in the cluster as Mercury's contribution to the seven-fold work.

canonical_texts.note: Lee Sharks's original poem and the Mercury/TACHYON substrate-transform. The transform_of edge passes through the Mercury sphere.
canonical_texts.modeling_note: v0.2 modeling decision: the TACHYON/Shadow pair is rendered as a *paired star* (is_pair=True) where the two source files (sharks-tachyon-poem and shadow-tachyon) are co-located at the constellation point. The transform relation is intrinsic to the pair rather than an outbound edge. If a separate transform_of edge is needed in the future, both halves should be split into distinct canon-stars: tachyon-poem (source) and shadow-tachyon (transform), with the transform_of edge between them. For v0.1 starmap rendering, the pair is one star.

canonical_texts.title: Day and Night: Conversations with Sapphic Desire (73 translations)

target_star.name: Pollux
target_star.assignment_basis: Pollux — the immortal twin, paired with Castor across the Gemini line. Cranes's translation work spans the line — 73 translations crossing between source and target.

canonical_texts.note: 73 translations from the Greek lyric poets. Five movements (First Rays → Bright Morning → Zenith → Fading Light → Middle Night). Sappho 31 + Catullus 51 in Bright Morning. Sappho 1 anchor of Zenith. Sappho 58 anchor of Middle Night.
